name: page-model-card-parity
goal: Page Models use unchanged catalog cards and exclude type collections at every revision

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: 428eac5a6 introduced context-specific footer suppression. Existing registry category also treats .types collections as models, exposed by new transitive page dependencies. Preserve source names and categorize type collections separately.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Existing category and Page Models tests accepted kind=model alone and checked only model link text. Extend the normal shared fixture with paired Order and Order.types, compare complete catalog/relationship cards, and exercise footer previews at current/historical revisions and all viewports.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: c98931909 committed tests fail in a clean installed snapshot on both classification and full card equality; all three browser viewports also fail on the missing Used In footer. Before captures inspected.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Restore the canonical catalog card without context overrides. Apply the existing model-versus-type-collection naming contract in the shared classifier. Extend standardized category/card acceptance matrices with paired sources and complete card equality.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Removed showUsage from the shared API and Page Models caller. Type collections become uncategorized Type definitions while real model sources retain identity. Standard tests now compare full catalog cards and reject sibling type collections at current and historical revisions.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: a4c95e9d3: unchanged category/relationship tests pass in a clean installed snapshot with the same controlled environment; current/historical Page Models browser flows pass at desktop/tablet/mobile, including consumer hover previews.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: At a4c95e9d3, isolated committed snapshot rejects each restored defect independently: classifier restoration fails Type collections are not data models; UI restoration fails Page Models keep the complete catalog card. Restored snapshot passes all 18 tests. Logs and snapshot path retained in /tmp/harness-model-correction-guard.json.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
steps.evidence: Focused verification passes: 668 Reports unit tests, 54 browser cases across desktop/tablet/mobile, Reports/root type checks, format/lint/build, root audit and units check. Reports audit remains blocked by unchanged entityPreviewFunctions.ts at 232 lines against 220. Full CLI/native suites are explicitly deferred; main merge remains held. Actual page empty state and synthetic real-model cards inspected.
